title: Looks like autoprefixer is not applied

comments.body:
> I removed my keyframe mixin

You mean we removed something and the icons are not showing up anymore? And that we now need to run autoprefixer on the docs css? If so I will add it.
I had a mixin to write vendor prefix for every keyframe and I removed it because I thought we where using autoprefixer. And obviously we are not.
Hmmm, weird because we do use autoprefixer https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/master/scripts/build.sh#L32
Oh wait, we use autoprefixer for the example CSS but not for the main website's one. On it.
My keyframes declarations was wrong. Fixed in [#704](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/704)
